title: Manual check in Chrome, Safari and Firefox beside a DAW through apricity serve --link
description:
## Intent
Check by ear in each browser what node tests can't.

## Steps (record results as a comment)
1. `apricity serve --library <dir> --link`, open the app from it in Chrome, Safari and Firefox.
2. In the DAW: Link and Start Stop Sync on, metronome on, 124 BPM. Turn Link on in the app, press play on a score with a clear click or drum clip: waits, then starts on the DAW's bar line.
3. Tempo change mid-bar, a slow tempo drag, stop and start, an edit while playing: no flams beyond the browser tolerance.
4. Kill `apricity serve` for 10 s and restart it: the app keeps playing, shows lost, re-aligns.
5. Put the tab in the background for a minute and come back.

## Verify
A comment per browser with each step's result and versions; bugs filed as `bug` under M3.

Labels `daw`, `web`. Commit: none (manual check).
